descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S22 Panel matches the p72 prototype; deliberate deviations listed for Daniela

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T1 Functionality and design match the p72 prototype's TranscriptHistory: row style, line-count chip, chevron, one open at a time, and longer lists folded into 'Earlier sessions'. (TFA-92594 AC 1)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Prototype TranscriptHistory (handoff-docs/RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html :6680-6760) and the app's TranscriptHistoryPanel

When Compare side by side: placement on the Encounter tab, row layout, history icon, '{n} lines' chip, chevron, inner scroll height, Physician/Patient colours, grouping above four sessions, order

Then Matches the prototype, except for deviations Daniela accepts (Q11)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Human side-by-side review. The behavioural parts (one open at a time, grouping) are automated in S01/S07. Deviations Daniela accepts are Q11. The prototype's retention (per-stay bedside history, ~48 h archive, three Nursing Home visits) conflicts with AC 2 / 3.6 and is Q12: a Fail on S10, S11 or S23 is not routed back as 'built to the prototype' until Q12 is answered

Where it ran: dev; test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S22 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-16.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
